label: Modern genre default skill base
description: Shared chargen baseline for modern Palladium genres (Nightbane; Heroes Unlimited / Beyond the Supernatural / Dead Reign when those genres are wired). Language Native is a flat 98% proficiency; Literacy Native and Math: Basic contribute additive educational bonuses that stack with any O.C.C. bonusPercent for the same skill id.

skills.notes: Select native tongue via Literacy/Language specialization. Flat proficiency — not catalog Language base 50%.
Same written language as native Language. Maps to skill_literacy for prerequisite ownership (e.g. Computer Operation).
Stacks with O.C.C. Math: Basic bonusPercent when the package also grants the skill.
